title: Music
description: Gig posters, tour posters and record promos. Some are recreations of real concerts; others are new artwork for shows that really happened.

title: Screen & Stage
description: Film posters and theatre bills, from Kubrick to the old variety houses.

title: Books & Comics
description: Reimagined book covers and comic-strip characters. Orwell, Huxley, Burgess, and Desperate Dan.

title: Pop Art
description: Comic-panel melodrama in the Lichtenstein manner, with alternative captions — plus a few other things borrowed from the sixties.

title: Vintage & Ephemera
description: Tickets, pin-ups and odds and ends that don't sit anywhere else.
